newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising on fresh commitments.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising on fresh commitments.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may move up as small investors plan fresh commitments to end two days of sheepish trading, brokers said.
"The small investors may show fresh interest after two days of slow movement. The market has now more or less stablised by a limited correction," said broker Mahbub Morshed.
Broker Shakil Rizvi said: "The demand structure is very strong with long peaceful political atmosphere in the country."
Brokers said blue scrips like Atlas Bangladesh, National Tubes, Beximco Pharma and ACI Ltd might attract investment.
The DSE benchmark index closed 2.06 points or 0.12 percent up at 1,665 on a turnover of 149.4 million taka on Sunday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
